commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Joan Jordan (Alaves) elects to shoot from distance instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
90+5' Alex Kral (Espanyol) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+3' Fouls committed – 15:14.
90+2' Referee Juan Pulido has finally had enough of Luis Garcia Plaza and brandishes a yellow card at him!

90+1' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Pulido with no other option than to blow for a foul.
